exposure: Timing of coital urinary incontinence (penetration, intercourse, orgasm, combination)
Type of urinary incontinence (stress, urgency, mixed)
outcome: Risk factors for coital urinary incontinence
Impact of coital urinary incontinence on sexual life and quality of life
cohort: Sexually active women with urinary incontinence in a stable relationship for at least 6 months
finding: Coital urinary incontinence is an underestimated clinical problem that can negatively impact quality of life, and its presence and impact on sexual function should be investigated in women with urinary incontinence.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was a protective factor for coital urinary incontinence.
